subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@enterprisebank.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Jun 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier today. Quick recap and a proposed POC/ trial outline so we can align on success criteria and next steps. Attached is a concise POC outline (Redwood-POC-Outline-EnterpriseBank.pdf).

Demo highlights:
- Real-time generation and chat flows with 75ms median token latency on our dedicated small-batch profile.
- Embedding-based semantic search integrated with your sample transaction dataset (demoed).
- Built-in observability: per-route latency and token cost breakdowns.

Proposed POC scope (3 weeks, small-scope trial):
1) Objective: Validate Redwood can deliver sub-150ms end-to-end latency for prioritized read-only flows and produce higher-quality summaries for 3 sample use cases (customer support, transaction summarization, and compliance triage).
2) Success criteria (please confirm / adjust):
   - Avg/median response latency <= 150ms for 95th percentile of test queries.
   - Summaries reach >= 80% acceptance by SME review (we'll provide a simple rubric).
   - No raw customer PII persisted in hosted logs (we'll provide config and retention statements).
3) Deliverables:
   - Week 0: Kickoff & environment setup (test dataset ingestion, API keys, routing).
   - Week 1: Integration + baseline runs (benchmark latency/cost).
   - Week 2: Quality tuning (prompts, model variants, quantization profile) + final evaluation report.
4) Ownership:
   - Redwood: marissa@redwood.com (Sales), vivek@redwood.com (Solutions), engineering point: neha@redwood.com
   - Enterprise Bank: Alice (PM), Mike (Security/IT)
5) Logistics / next steps:
   - Please confirm success criteria and available times for kickoff next week.
   - Attachments: POC outline (PDF) and our standard ratecard (xlsx).

Notes on compliance: we can run the trial in a private VPC or dedicated hosted instance depending on your preference — happy to surface the SOC2/Security artifacts during kickoff.

Thanks — looking forward to your thoughts.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: Redwood-POC-Outline-EnterpriseBank.pdf (13KB stub), Redwood-Ratecard-Standard.xlsx (9KB stub)

From: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@enterprisebank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 06 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. A few quick items from our side: 

1) Success criteria: we agree with the latency target (<=150ms) and the SME acceptance threshold (>=80%). Can you confirm the exact test harness you plan to use for latency (synthetic vs replay of production queries)?

2) Data handling / compliance: we'll need to loop in our security team (I'll add Mike Torres) — they will want to review the retention settings and any logs that might contain metadata. For the POC we prefer to use a dedicated hosted instance (not shared) if that keeps setup simpler.

3) Timeline: Week of Jun 14 works for kickoff for our PM & engineering. Can you hold Jun 15 or Jun 16 in the morning?

4) Procurement: we'll need a short-term trial license and an indicative ratecard for budgeting (happy to receive draft).

I'll add Mike in the next reply.

Best,
Alice Johnson
Product Manager, AI Platform — Enterprise Bank
alice.johnson@enterprisebank.com

Hi Alice / Mike —

Thanks for the quick reply and for adding Mike. A few clarifications and proposed next steps: 

- Test harness: we'll provide a replay harness using a redacted subset of your production queries (we'll coordinate the export). This gives the most realistic latency numbers; we'll also run synthetic ramps to validate tail behavior.
- Hosting: dedicated hosted instance is fine for the POC. We'll stand that up with default 30-day retention on logs and can configure zero retention if you prefer.
- Security artifacts: attaching SOC2 summary and our security brief in the Drive link (see related links).

Proposed schedule (adjustable):
- Jun 15: Kickoff (60m) — align on dataset export, access, and security checklist.
- Jun 16-18: Integration + baseline testing.
- Jun 21-25: Tuning + SME reviews.
- Jun 28: Final evaluation and handoff (short report + recordings).

Action items for kickoff (we'll create a short agenda):
- EB: provide sample dataset export + point-of-contact for data transfer.
- Redwood: provision dedicated POC instance, share API keys, provide traffic/replay harness.

Pricing/procurement: attaching an indicative ratecard (Redwood-Ratecard-Standard.xlsx). For POC trials we typically provide a short-term trial license; Vivek will follow up with a license key and trial terms after kickoff sign-off.

Please confirm if Jun 15 (10:00 AM ET) works and I'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Marissa
